label: BCAN::NTRK1

sections.text: BCAN encodes brevican, a neural extracellular-matrix proteoglycan.
NTRK1 encodes TRKA, the nerve-growth-factor receptor tyrosine kinase.
The fusion joins BCAN sequences to the retained NTRK1 kinase, producing an oncogenic TRKA signaling protein. Chromosomal-engineering experiments demonstrated glioma-driving activity.

Oncogenic NTRK-fusion-positive advanced solid tumors can qualify for TRK inhibition; larotrectinib criteria include absence of known acquired TRK resistance mutations and prior progression or no satisfactory alternatives.
